approves.text: DEC-029 (accepted by the Project Owner 2026-11-05): B6 is reported as two separate statements. (a) GFL measures the B6 leading-edge spread rate from the original NASA stills at 2.27 mm/s (processing range 2.1-2.4 mm/s; uncertainty budget provisional). (b) This is of the same magnitude as the approximate B6 value reported by Carmignani (2019), approximately 2 mm/s, whose threshold and uncertainty are not published. The word 'validated' and the phrase 'within uncertainty' are not used for B6.
